metadata.question: Did the area around Walvis Bay, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Need to compare NDVI for February 2021 vs. the average of February months from 2010-2020 around Walvis Bay, Namibia - Use Sentinel-2 (preferred for NDVI, available from 2015) or Landsat 8 (available from 2013) for recent data - For 2010-2012: only Landsat 7/5 available; for 2013+: Landsat 8; for 2015+: Sentinel-2 - Walvis Bay coords: approximately -22.95°S, 14.5°E 2. **Masking strategy**: - Cloud mask using QA bands (Sentinel-2: QA60, Landsat: pixel_qa) - This is not about cloud analysis, so mask out clouds - Calculate NDVI = (NIR - RED) / (NIR + RED) 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check collection sizes at each step - Check pixel counts after masking - NDVI should be in range [-1, 1]; values outside indicate errors - Compare 2021 February NDVI vs. mean of 2010-2020 February NDVIs - Answer A if 2021 > average, B if 2021 ≤ average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Walvis Bay, Namibia const geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([14.5, -22.95]); const buffer = geometry.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer // Helper: mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return image.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))); } // Helper: calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { return image.addBands( image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI') ); } // Collect Sentinel-2 data for February 2021 const feb2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-02-28') .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const feb2021Count = feb2021.size().getInfo(); print('Feb 2021 Images:', feb2021Count); if (feb2021Count === 0) { print('No data for Feb 2021'); print('C1'); return; } // Calculate February 2021 mean NDVI const feb2021NDVI = feb2021.select('NDVI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) .reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 } ); const val2021 = feb2021NDVI.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); print('Feb 2021 Mean NDVI:', val2021 !== null ? val2021.toFixed(4) : 'null'); if (val2021 === null || isNaN(val2021) || val2021 < -1 || val2021 > 1) { print('C3'); return; } // Collect historical February data (2010-2020) let historicalNDVI = []; let validYears = 0; for (let year = 2010; year <= 2020; year++) { let col; if (year >= 2015) { // Sentinel-2 col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(`${year}-02-01`, `${year}-02-28`) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); } else if (year >= 2013) { // Landsat 8 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(`${year}-02-01`, `${year}-02-28`) .map(function(img) { return img.updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0)); }) .map(function(img) { return img.addBands(img.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')); }); } else { // Landsat 7 or 5 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(`${year}-02-01`, `${year}-02-28`) .map(function(img) { return img.updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0)); }) .map(function(img) { return img.addBands(img.normalizedDifference(['B4', 'B3']).rename('NDVI')); }); } const count = col.size().getInfo(); if (count > 0) { const ndvi = col.select('NDVI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) .reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 } ) .get('NDVI_mean') .getInfo(); if (ndvi !== null && !isNaN(ndvi) && ndvi >= -1 && ndvi <= 1) { historicalNDVI.push(ndvi); validYears++; print(`Feb ${year}: NDVI=${ndvi.toFixed(4)}`); } } } print(`Valid years: ${validYears}`); if (validYears === 0) { print('No valid historical data'); print('C1'); return; } const avgHistorical = historicalNDVI.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / validYears; print(`Feb 2010-2020 Avg NDVI: ${avgHistorical.toFixed(4)}`); print(`Feb 2021 NDVI: ${val2021.toFixed(4)}`); if (val2021 > avgHistorical) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
